text: dsh-model-picker-search 是一个 DSH 网页插件，在聊天输入区的模型选择菜单中加入可搜索的模型列表，并保留模型推理强度选择。它替换 conversation.input.model 插槽，读取并更新按会话共享的 ModelDirectory，因此选择会与原有模型选择界面保持一致。用户可以按模型 ID、名称或提供方名称筛选模型，也可以选择模型和推理强度。适合希望快速查找并切换模型的 DSH 网页用户。代码未要求额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-model-picker-search adds searchable model and reasoning effort menus to the DSH web composer. It shares the per-session ModelDirectory so model choices stay consistent. Search by model or provider name, then select a model and effort level.
我想在模型菜单里直接搜模型名称。
能不能按提供方筛选可用模型？
I want to search models in the composer picker.
dsh-model-picker-search 的功能「搜索并选择模型」：打开聊天输入区的模型菜单后，可按模型 ID、名称或提供方名称实时筛选；选择一项后更新当前会话模型。

dsh-model-picker-search README · dsh-model-picker-search：DSH Web GUI plugin. Adds a live search field inside the model picker menu
of the composer, plus the **Effort** (reasoning) selector that the native
`ModelSelect` ships with.

dsh-model-picker-search README · dsh-model-picker-search：When you click the **Model** button in the composer, the menu now opens
already focused on a search box at the top. As you type, the list of
models is filtered in real time across every provider — matching against
the model `id`, model `name`, provider `displayName`, and provider `name`
(case-insensitive substring). The two-level (Model / Effort) submenu from
the native picker is preserved, so switching reasoning effort on a model
that supports it still works as before.

dsh-model-picker-search README · dsh-model-picker-search：The plugin reads and writes the same per-session `ModelDirectory` the
native `ModelSelect` and `/model` popup consume, so every entry surface
stays consistent: select a model in the composer picker, and the
`/model` command in the chat shows the same selection; change effort
here, and the trigger label updates to show it.

No source code of DSH is modified — the plugin composes a new occupant
for the `conversation.input.model` slot, which DSH was designed to allow.

dsh-model-picker-search README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-model-picker-search
```

Then restart `dsh web` (or refresh the page so the new bundle is picked
up).

dsh-model-picker-search README · How it works：- **Client** (`lib/client.js`): registers a single occupant for the
  `conversation.input.model` slot. The component renders:
  - a trigger button matching the native `_7KE1Ra_trigger` look (label +
    optional effort caption + chevron that rotates 180° when open);
  - a two-pane menu (Model / Effort) styled with the same theme tokens as
    the shipped menu;
  - on the Model pane, a `<input type="text">` at the top that filters
    the model list as the user types;
  - on the Effort pane, the list of reasoning effort levels for the
    current model, plus a "Provider default" option when the model
    declares no default.
- **Host** (`lib/index.js`): a no-op entry kept so the bundle has a valid
  host half. The plugin is driven entirely by the client — model data
  comes from the shared `ModelDirectory`, so no host route or RPC is
  needed and no host-side state is duplicated.

dsh-model-picker-search README · How it works：The injected `ModelDirectory` (`ctx.modelDirectories.directoryFor(sessionId)`)
is the same instance the native seat uses, which is what makes the two
entry surfaces share their state.

dsh-model-picker-search README · UX details：- **Auto-focus.** The search input is focused as soon as the Model pane
  opens, so the user can start typing without an extra click. The focus
  call uses `requestAnimationFrame` to ensure the input is fully mounted
  and `focus({ preventScroll: true })` to avoid pushing the page.
- **Back button.** Each sub-pane has a "‹ Back" button that returns to
  the root pane, matching the native two-level menu.
- **Outside click.** Clicking outside the menu closes it and resets the
  query. ESC and the chevron toggle behave like the native picker.
- **Effort preservation.** When you pick a model, the plugin preserves
  the current `reasoningEffort` if it's still valid for the new model
  (matches the way the native seat handles it).

dsh-model-picker-search README · Compatibility：- DSH 0.1.0-rc.8 or newer (uses the `dsh.client` package metadata,
  `ctx.modelDirectories`, and the `conversation.input.model` slot).
- Themes: all colors and spacing come from DSH theme tokens
  (`--dsw-alias-*`, `--dsw-specific-menu`, `--dsw-shadow-lv3`,
  `--dsw-alias-scrollbar-bg-l2`), so it follows light/dark and the
  brand overrides.
